info.title: Kognos API
info.description: Documentación de la API REST para la plataforma Kognos.

get.description: Returns a list of all courses available to the public. No authentication required.

post.description: Allows an authenticated admin user with the 'create-course' permission to create a new course with multiple chapters and YouTube videos.

403.description: Forbidden - user lacks necessary role or permission

items.example: The content must be an array.

get.summary: Get full details of a specific course
get.description: Returns detailed information about a specific course, including chapters and videos. If authenticated, the response includes the user's enrollment status, progress, completed chapters and medal.

parameters.name: course
parameters.description: ID of the course to retrieve

description.example: Complete Laravel course from beginner to advanced

put.description: Allows an authenticated admin user to update an existing course, including its title, description, chapters, and embedded video URLs.

parameters.name: course
parameters.description: ID of the course to update

403.description: Forbidden - user lacks necessary role or permission

items.example: The content must be an array.

delete.description: Allows an authenticated admin user to delete an existing course by its ID.

parameters.name: course
parameters.description: ID of the course to delete

403.description: Forbidden - user lacks necessary role or permission

post.description: Authenticates a user using email and password, and returns an access token if credentials are valid.
Creates a new user account and returns an access token. The user will be automatically assigned the 'user' role.

items.example: The username must be at least 2 characters.
The email has already been taken.
The password confirmation does not match.

post.description: Marks a chapter as completed for the authenticated user. Updates the user's progress and assigns a medal based on the percentage of completion. Requires the user to be enrolled in the course.

parameters.name: chapterIndex
parameters.description: Index of the chapter to complete (starting from 0)

403.description: Forbidden - user not enrolled in the course or lacks 'user' role

message.example: You are not enrolled in this course.

get.summary: Get all users with their enrolled courses
get.description: Returns a list of all users with their associated courses, including progress and medal. Only accessible to authenticated admin users.

403.description: Forbidden - user does not have admin role

get.description: Returns the authenticated user's information and their enrolled courses. Admin users can view any user's data. Regular users can only access their own information.

parameters.name: user
parameters.description: ID of the user to retrieve

403.description: Forbidden - user lacks permission to view this resource

delete.description: Allows a user to delete **only their own account**. Also deletes all access tokens associated with the user. Requires authentication and 'user' role.

parameters.name: user
parameters.description: ID of the user to delete (must match the authenticated user)

204.description: User account deleted successfully. No content is returned.

403.description: Forbidden - trying to delete another user's account or lacking role

post.description: Allows an authenticated user with the 'user' role and appropriate permission to enroll in a course. Returns a confirmation message or a conflict if already enrolled.

parameters.name: course
parameters.description: ID of the course to enroll in

message.example: You have successfully enrolled in the course

409.description: Conflict - user already enrolled in course

message.example: You have already enrolled in the course

post.description: Allows an authenticated user to unenroll from a course they are currently enrolled in. Returns a confirmation message or a conflict if the user is not enrolled.

parameters.name: course
parameters.description: ID of the course to unenroll from

message.example: You have successfully unenrolled from the course

409.description: Conflict - user is not enrolled in the course

message.example: You have not enrolled in the course
